primary_sources.description: Qureshi & Zaman, [Social Media Engagement and Cryptocurrency Performance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2209.02911), research paper. Related peer-reviewed full text: [PLOS/PMC](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC10174546/).
Szwajcok et al., [Meme Coin Factories: Uncovering Large-Scale Manipulations on pump.fun](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.10246), September 2026 preprint.
[marlowxbt/trace](https://github.com/marlowxbt/trace), original project documentation describing a pre-existing attention-spike detector.
[DEX Screener API reference](https://docs.dexscreener.com/api/reference), provider documentation.
[PumpPortal fees](https://pumpportal.fun/fees/), provider fee schedule.
[PumpPortal real-time data](https://pumpportal.fun/data-api/real-time/), provider websocket documentation.
[Pump fees](https://pump.fun/docs/fees), current schedule updated October 8, 2026.
[Alpaca crypto spot fees](https://docs.alpaca.markets/us/docs/crypto-fees), official fee schedule.
[Alpaca supported cryptocurrencies](https://alpaca.markets/support/what-cryptocurrencies-does-alpaca-currently-support), official asset list.
[X API pricing](https://docs.x.com/x-api/getting-started/pricing), official resource-based pricing.
[PumpPortal terms](https://pumpportal.fun/legal/), provider eligibility and access terms.
[Pump terms](https://pump.fun/docs/terms-and-conditions), updated October 8, 2026.
[SEC staff statement on meme coins](https://www.sec.gov/newsroom/speeches-statements/staff-statement-meme-coins), February 27, 2025.
[IRS digital assets](https://www.irs.gov/filing/digital-assets), official record/reporting guidance.

[Solana transaction fees](https://solana.com/docs/core/fees) and [token account creation costs](https://solana.com/docs/tokens/basics/create-token-account), official protocol documentation; quoted account sizes/rent vary and must be queried.
[PumpPortal Local trading API](https://pumpportal.fun/local-trading-api/trading-api/), supported route parameters. Reviewed as a future implementation reference; no order called.
Corrected public rejection corpus v2.3; archive checksum verified, selected fields retained without filtering rows.
External paper-trading benchmark v1.3; return/account arithmetic independently audited.
Official public crypto-data guidance; unauthenticated historical bar endpoint verified.
Official PumpSwap program documentation: account layout, effective quote reserves and SDK quoting guidance.
Official Pump fee-program documentation and current fee schedule: dynamic tier selection and published rates.
Official Solana getMultipleAccounts RPC documentation and official PumpSwap SDK package pinned at 2.1.0.
Alpaca real-time crypto schemas: source timestamps, bid/ask updates and taker side; venue-specific data.
Cont, Kukanov and Stoikov, The Price Impact of Order Book Events; stock-market OFI prior art, not a meme-coin validation.
Solana signatures and finalized transaction retrieval; pool references do not themselves establish swaps.
Solana v1 read compatibility: opt into integer maxSupportedTransactionVersion=1; verified explicit errors and recovery.
Anchor event provenance, invoking-program checks, successful transaction metadata and log/CPI limitations.
Official Alpaca historical quote/trade pagination; 93 trades and 249457 raw quote rows captured with UTC receipts.
MemeTrans/MELT research and successor repository; commercial-use licence restriction assessed, dataset/code/predictions not adopted.
Official Solana refundable account storage balance; locked rent is excluded until an evidenced refund.
Official Solana network fee structure; fees charged even for transaction failure. No priority-fee amount or failure rate assumed.
CatBoost original ordered-boosting/categorical-feature paper; proposed numeric-model comparator, no memecoin benchmark
DeepHit original competing-risk survival paper; later neural-method candidate, not trained
TabPFN small-tabular-data Nature paper, published January 8 2025; not financial-return validation
Original generic temporal-convolution sequence-modeling study
Original Temporal Graph Networks method paper; no independent-wallet certification
Current TabPFN implementation and separately licensed model weights; v2 attribution terms versus newer noncommercial weights
Official PumpSwap IDL with signer and exact mint/token-account roles; captured raw content and receipt
Official OpenAI cross-device conversation history, separate local-folder access and desktop project setup
Official Solana token account closure and wrapped SOL exception; transient accounts require initialization evidence
Pump creator-fee role and permissionless collection; event role is not proof of a mint-creation signer or human identity
Solana WSOL balance syncing, transfer owner/authority roles and fee sponsorship
Circle supported native USDC mint, identity only; no assumed redemption value or user eligibility
Tether supported protocols and exact Solana USDT mint; no assumed one-USD value
DEX Screener paid-order, boosting and API documentation; visibility confounder without causal return attribution
Bluesky public AppView and searchPosts Lexicon; inaccessible or incomplete search is not zero attention
Official complete Pump AMM BuyEvent and SellEvent schema, pinned for instruction-aware fee decoding
Official PumpSwap LP, protocol and creator-fee documentation
Official trade-v3 fee-routing documentation; buyback is a portion of protocol fee
